name: AutoRE
description: End-to-end DocRE model using RHF paradigm with 3 QLoRA modules. SOTA on Re-DocRED (53.84% F1 with Vicuna-7B).

name: RHF (Relation-Head-Facts)
description: Novel RE paradigm: first extract Relations present in document, then identify Head entities for each relation, then derive triple Facts. Key innovation: does NOT assume known relation options.

name: D-F (Document-Facts)
description: Simplest RE paradigm: given document, directly output all triplet facts. F1=6.68 on raw ChatGPT.

name: D-RS-F (Document-Relations-Facts)
description: RE paradigm: extract relations, embed predicted relations into prompts as candidates, then extract facts. F1=7.50 on raw ChatGPT. Impractical with 96+ relation types.

name: D-R-F (Document-Relation-Facts)
description: RE paradigm: identify relations, then systematically traverse each to extract facts. F1=2.97 on raw ChatGPT.

name: D-R-H-F (Document-Relation-Head-Facts)
description: The RHF paradigm formalized: R->H->F decomposition. Worst on raw ChatGPT (F1=1.81) but BEST with QLoRA fine-tuning (F1=53.01). The paradox: more decomposition hurts raw LLMs but enables better fine-tuning.

name: QLoRA
description: Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation. Combines 4-bit quantization with LoRA for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. AutoRE uses 3 independent QLoRA modules (one per RHF step).

name: LoRA
description: Low-Rank Adaptation for efficient LLM fine-tuning. Freezes pretrained weights, adds trainable rank decomposition matrices.

name: PEFT (Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning)
description: General approach to fine-tune LLMs by updating only a small subset of parameters. Includes LoRA, QLoRA, prefix tuning, adapters.

name: ChatIE
description: Decomposes RE into multi-round QA, assembles outputs into structured format. +16.65% over single-prompt extraction.

name: InstructUIE
description: Multi-task instruction tuning for unified IE. Uses prompt templates for RE tasks.

name: YAYI-UIE
description: Chat-enhanced instruction tuning framework for universal information extraction.

name: TAG (Table-to-Graph)
description: Table-to-graph approach for document-level joint entity and relation extraction. Previous SOTA on Re-DocRED (49.38% F1 test).

name: GPT-NER
description: Named entity recognition via large language models.

name: LEAP
description: LLM instruction-example adaptive prompting for clinical relation extraction.

name: GPT-4
description: OpenAI's most capable LLM. Referenced as exemplar of LLM progress.

name: GPT-3.5-turbo (ChatGPT)
description: OpenAI's chat model used as baseline in AutoRE experiments. All 4 paradigms evaluated on it. Best raw result: D-RS-F F1=7.50.

name: Llama 2
description: Meta's open-source LLM foundation model.

name: Mistral-7B
description: 7B parameter instruction-tuned LLM. Primary model for AutoRE. F1=53.01 dev, 51.91 test on Re-DocRED.

name: Vicuna-7B-v1.5
description: Open-source chatbot achieving 90% ChatGPT quality. Best AutoRE results: F1=54.29 dev, 53.84 test on Re-DocRED.

name: ChatGLM3-6B
description: 6B parameter Chinese-English bilingual model with autoregressive blank infilling. AutoRE results: F1=49.86 dev, 51.11 test.

name: BERT
description: Bidirectional transformer encoder. BERT-based RE models outperform ChatGPT on Standard-IE tasks.

name: Re-DocRED
description: Revised DocRED dataset fixing false negative problems. 96 relation types. Dev: 498 articles, 17236 triplets. Test: 499 articles, 17448 triplets.

name: DocRED
description: Original large-scale document-level RE dataset. Had false negative annotation issues, revised as Re-DocRED.

name: Wikidata
description: Source of original relation descriptions used in Re-DocRED. AutoRE rewrites these descriptions for clarity (+44% F1 improvement).

name: Strict Micro F1
description: Primary evaluation metric for DocRE. Requires exact match of relation type, head entity, AND tail entity for a triple to count as correct.

name: Document-Level Relation Extraction (DocRE)
description: Extracting relational facts from full documents (not single sentences). Challenges: multiple relations per document, cross-sentence reasoning, large relation type sets (96+).

name: Relation Extraction (RE)
description: Extracting structured relational facts (head, relation, tail) from text. Subtypes: sentence-level, document-level, few-shot, zero-shot.

name: Named Entity Recognition (NER)
description: Identifying and classifying named entities in text. Related IE task referenced in AutoRE context.

name: Event Extraction (EE)
description: Extracting structured event information from text. Related IE task referenced in AutoRE context.

name: Information Extraction (IE)
description: Parent task encompassing NER, RE, EE. Converting unstructured text into structured knowledge.

name: Relation Description Rewriting
description: Key AutoRE innovation: rewrote all 96 Wikidata relation descriptions with clearer text and examples. E.g., 'located in the administrative territorial entity' gets example: '(Harvard University, located in, Cambridge, Massachusetts)'. Improves F1 from 6.44 to 14.04 for D-R-F paradigm.

name: Multi-turn QA Decomposition
description: Breaking complex extraction into sequential question-answer steps. Used by ChatIE (+16.65%) and RHF paradigm.

name: Instruction Tuning
description: Fine-tuning LLMs on instruction-formatted data. Used by InstructUIE and YAYI-UIE for unified IE.

name: Triplet Facts
description: The extraction target in RE: (head_entity, relation, tail_entity). AutoRE extracts these via 3-step decomposition.

name: Pipeline Architecture (for RE)
description: Modular extraction approach with independent specialized components. AutoRE uses 3 independent QLoRA modules (pipeline). Contrasts with end-to-end single-model approaches.

name: Decomposition Paradox
description: Key empirical finding: D-R-H-F (most decomposed) is WORST on raw ChatGPT (F1=1.81) but BEST with QLoRA fine-tuning (F1=53.01). More decomposition hurts unfine-tuned LLMs but enables better fine-tuning. Error accumulation vs. task simplification trade-off.

name: Distant Supervision
description: Using LLMs for semi-automatic document-level RE enhancement via distant supervision.
